speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the severity and location of your flank pain, and have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any burning sensation or urgency when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood or cloudiness in your urine? I will also check your abdomen for tenderness over the kidney area.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you develop the rash after starting cephalexin, and have you noticed any swelling in your face or joints? I need to rule out a drug reaction or serum sickness.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present; Urine Culture: Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative urine culture despite leukocyturia and your history of recent antibiotic use, I suspect a drug-induced interstitial nephritis. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound

speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication. with perspicacious discernment
